name: mechanical
description: Use when you already know the change and the place it goes, and could describe the diff before opening the editor — the cost of being wrong about it is small. Implement, commit as the transition, then PR; the test suite is the reviewer. Not for work whose shape still needs deciding (planned) or that deserves a second reader before it ships (shaped).

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task; the transition commits its work

stages.name: pr
stages.description: Agent creates a GitHub PR and hands off to the merge master
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the work on branch $BRANCH.
